title: 美银乔虹：中国应对高油价有三大优势
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: Well, I think the oil prices staying at elevated levels are presenting some gross challenges, not only to China, but also the rest of Asia in general.
segments.zh: 我认为油价持续高位给中国乃至整个亚洲带来增长挑战。

segments.en: But for China, I think it is better prepared because of the following reasons. Number one, it has a large strategic reserve so that they can draw upon when things get hotter.
segments.zh: 但中国准备更充分，原因如下：第一，拥有大规模战略储备，可在形势紧张时动用。

segments.en: And two, they also have more diversified origins where sources of energy. And therefore, they are less impacted by GCC country issues and the transportation through the straight up for most.
segments.zh: 第二，能源来源更多元化，因此受海湾国家问题及霍尔木兹海峡运输影响较小。

segments.en: But number three, I think also very importantly, China has developed a lot of renewable energies in the recent past. So, you know, I would say that is contributing a lot to the more diversified energy demand that China currently has.
segments.zh: 第三，也是非常重要的一点，中国近年来大力发展可再生能源，这极大地促进了能源需求多元化。

segments.en: So we are about to see that when oil prices come down, it will help China, you know, get inflation a little bit lower, especially coming from the energy part. We need the good inflation, not the energy inflation, right?
segments.zh: 因此，当油价下跌时，将有助于中国降低通胀，尤其是能源部分。我们需要的是良性通胀，而非能源通胀。

segments.en: But at the same time, you know, in addition to that terms of trade gain, we are also seeing that China could potentially, you know, see a little bit of upside for corporate and also for household when the energy prices are lower so that demand can recover better.
segments.zh: 同时，除了贸易条件改善，能源价格下降还可能提振企业和家庭，从而更好地恢复需求。
